xmldoc.short_description: Customize brace indexing of a class.

param_input_item.param_description: an object of a class deriving from nelson.mixin.indexing.RedefinesBrace.

param_output_item.param_description: an object supporting customized brace indexing.

description.p: Derive from nelson.mixin.indexing.RedefinesBrace to give a class its own brace indexing behavior. A subclass implements the protected methods braceReference(obj, indexOp) (value of obj{...}), braceAssign(obj, indexOp, value) (obj{...} = value) and braceListLength(obj, indexOp, indexContext).
indexOp is a nelson.indexing.IndexingOperation whose Indices property is a cell array of the subscripts.
